name: kura
description: A local Ethereum wallet for AI agents — read balances, pay with x402. The key never leaves this Mac.
long_description:
Connects to the installed Kura app to read balances and history, and to **ask** for payments. By default a payment only goes out after the app opens an approval window and a human approves it with their password (automatic approval without a password happens only if the user turned autopay on themselves, and only within an unlocked session, a small limit, and a trusted address). Passwords and recovery phrases are typed in the app alone — they never enter a conversation or a config file.

This extension contains no executable. It verifies and runs the signed, notarized binary inside the installed Kura.app. Install Kura first: https://github.com/dinggi5/kura

tools.name: request_payment
tools.description: Ask to pay — by default a human approves it with their password in the app (automatic only within the autopay limit and trusted addresses, if turned on)

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch an x402 paid resource — if payment is required, the same approval rules apply
